svg.title: R6 · C3 regulated carrier · 18 × 24 holes — top worksheet
svg.text: 18 columns × 24 rows A–X · 2.54 mm pitch · nominal outline 47.78 × 63.02 mm · not a drilling template
LEGS / ADAPTER PINS · role → carrier hole
G1→U2 S1→V2 D1→V5 G2→U5 S2→T5 D2→T2
DSTART stripe = cathode K at N6.
Adapter pin roles refer to the identified SOT23 board, not a TO92 body. Fit only the
specified footprints. Identify actual E/B/C legs before insertion. Each channel
keeps its own gate resistor and pulldown.
Dashed ESP, CHG, REG5 and REG12 zones are raised +12 mm, not header patterns. Exact nets
and joints: bottom sheet. Module pigtails: modules sheet.
432 isolated pads · square = wire attachment · use all three carrier sheets
R6 prototype / physical verification pending. Charge fully OFF. Battery negative → B−; system ground → OUT−.
